items.question: Within how many days of a baby's birth abroad must UAE citizen parents apply for the baby's birth certificate at the UAE embassy?
items.gold: Parents must apply for birth certificate within 30 days of the birth of the baby.
items.fact: UAE citizen parents must apply within 30 days of birth

items.question: If a death certificate was issued abroad for a UAE national who died there, which UAE body attests it before the body is transported to the UAE?
items.gold: The UAE embassy in the country where death occurred attests the death certificate.
items.fact: UAE embassy in death country attests foreign death certificate
